mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an accommodative monetary policy and potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining federal funds rate and increasing consumer price index (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment rate and strong payroll employment growth signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts signals a weak demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when housing starts are below 1500 (t-test p > 0.05).
